title: Shipment notices (ASN)
requirement: Supplier users shall create shipment notices against issued or acknowledged order lines (quantities not above open quantity, ship date, expected date, carrier, tracking, packages, attachments), save and submit; buyers shall approve or reject when approval is configured; approved notices are shown when creating receipts.
acceptance_criteria: Given open lines, When a notice is submitted, Then the buyer is notified and the notice is In Approval or Approved per configuration.|Given a quantity above open quantity, When submitted, Then it is refused naming the line. (error case)|Given an approved notice, When a receipt is created, Then its lines are offered with announced quantities.
notes: Was FF-090. It obeys the supplier portal's ownership rule, SPX-006, and depends on the kernel requirements that enforce it (ADR-0042).

title: Shipment notice visibility and tracking
requirement: Buyers and receivers shall see notices per order and per expected date, with status; a notice may be marked received in full or partially by the receipts created from it.
acceptance_criteria: Given notices expected this week, When filtered, Then they are listed by date.|Given receipts created from a notice, When viewed, Then the notice shows received versus announced per line.|Given a notice cancelled by the supplier before receipt, When viewed, Then it is marked cancelled. (edge)|Given a notice marked received by a user without the receiving permission, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Create a receipt
requirement: Receivers shall create receipts against order lines (optionally from a notice) with received quantity and unit, warehouse, inspection result (accepted, rejected, damaged with quantities), received date, delivery note number, notes and attachments; the pending quantity shall be computed under row locks as ordered × (1 + tolerance) − receipts submitted − receipts approved, and a receipt above it shall be refused.
rationale: Gap: non-atomic check in the current product.
acceptance_criteria: Given two receipts created at once for the last 5 units, When processed, Then exactly one succeeds.|Given quantity above pending, When saved, Then "Quantity exceeds the open quantity of N" is shown. (error case)|Given a receipt in boxes for an order in each, When saved, Then the quantity is converted.

title: Receipt tolerance
requirement: Receipts shall respect the over-receipt tolerance stamped on the order line (else the legal entity or system tolerance) by percentage or value; receipts beyond tolerance are refused; receipts below quantity are allowed (partial deliveries).
acceptance_criteria: Given tolerance 5 percent and ordered 100, When 105 is received cumulatively, Then it is accepted; 106 is refused.|Given tolerance zero, When 101 is received, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a partial receipt, When saved, Then the remaining quantity is shown.

title: Inspection and warehouse
requirement: Inspection results per line (accepted, rejected, damaged quantities with reasons and photos) and warehouse or location shall be recorded; only accepted quantity counts as received for invoicing when the inspection setting is on; rejected quantities create a return proposal.
acceptance_criteria: Given 10 received with 2 rejected and the setting on, When approved, Then 8 counts for invoicing and a return proposal for 2 exists.|Given rejected quantity without reason, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given the setting off, When approved, Then the full received quantity counts.

title: Receipt submission and approval
requirement: Submission shall re-run the pending and tolerance checks, then route through the receipt approval configuration when receipt approval is required (a tenant-wide switch in version 1, with the setting model prepared for per-organisation, per-supplier and per-category control later), else approve directly; approved receipt lines become invoiceable for 3-way lines and update buckets.
acceptance_criteria: Given approval required, When submitted, Then approvers see it with lines and inspection.|Given approval not required, When submitted, Then it is Approved at once and buckets update.|Given approval, When done, Then the receipt date and approver are recorded. (edge)|Given a submitted receipt approved by the receiver who created it when self-approval is disallowed, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Receipt rejection and cancellation
requirement: Rejection by an approver releases the receipt quantity; cancellation of an approved receipt requires the permission, a reason, and is refused when any quantity has been invoiced (credit note path instead); both notify the receiver.
acceptance_criteria: Given an approved receipt partly invoiced, When cancel is attempted, Then it is refused naming the invoice. (error case)|Given rejection, When done, Then the pending quantity increases accordingly.|Given cancellation, When done, Then received approved decreases and the audit shows the reason.

title: Receipt documents and print
requirement: Receipts shall render as PDF with the legal entity template (goods receipt note) and be downloadable by buyers and the supplier.
acceptance_criteria: Given a template, When rendered, Then the PDF shows lines, quantities and inspection.|Given no template, When rendered, Then it is refused naming the template. (error case)|Given the supplier user, When they open their receipt, Then the same PDF is available.

title: Receiving delegation and requester receipts
requirement: Receiving duties shall be delegable (kernel delegation, the receiving duty); requesters may be allowed to confirm receipt for their own lines per configuration, creating receipts routed per the receipt approval setting.
acceptance_criteria: Given a delegation to user B, When B records a receipt for A's unit, Then it is allowed and attributed to both.|Given requester confirmation enabled, When the requester confirms, Then a receipt exists in their name.|Given requester confirmation disabled, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Receipt lists and supplier view
requirement: Receipt lists (all, per order, per supplier, pending approval) for buyers and receivers; suppliers see their receipts in the portal with quantities and inspection results.
acceptance_criteria: Given a supplier user, When listing, Then only their receipts appear.|Given filters by pending approval, When applied, Then only those appear.|Given a user without read permission, When opening, Then it is refused. (error case)
notes: Was FF-104. It obeys the supplier portal's ownership rule, SPX-006, and depends on the kernel requirements that enforce it (ADR-0042).

title: Service receipts
requirement: For service lines on amount basis, receipts shall record amount received (service entry) instead of quantity, with the same pending and tolerance logic on amounts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a service line of 10,000 and a service receipt of 6,000, When saved, Then open to receive is 4,000.|Given a service receipt above open amount plus tolerance, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given invoicing of the service line, When submitted, Then capacity uses received amounts for 3-way.

title: Service entry against an order line
requirement: A service entry shall be recorded against a service order line, with the period or the work it covers, an amount or a percentage of the line (RCV-044), notes and attachments; it counts as received only when it is accepted (RCV-045, RCV-046).
rationale: Services are delivered over time and confirmed by the people who used them, not counted at a dock.
acceptance_criteria: Given a service line of 10,000, When an entry of 2,500 for October is saved, Then it waits for acceptance and the open amount stays 10,000.|Given an entry above the open amount plus the stamped tolerance, When it is submitted, Then it is refused naming the open amount. (error case)|Given an entry on a line that is not a service line, When it is saved, Then it is refused; goods are received by receipt (RCV-021). (error case)
notes: New in the split, expanding RCV-041 (was FF-102). `[Decision]`: who records an entry. Proposed: the receiver or the requester in the tenant, and the supplier in the portal, where it waits for the requester's acceptance (section 7).

title: Service milestones
requirement: A service order line may be divided into milestones, each with a name, a due date and an amount or a percentage of the line, together making up the line; a service entry records a milestone as done.
rationale: Many services are paid by stages agreed with the supplier.
acceptance_criteria: Given milestones of 30, 30 and 40 percent on a line of 10,000, When saved, Then they are kept with their due dates and amounts 3,000, 3,000 and 4,000.|Given milestones that make up 90 percent of the line, When saved, Then it is refused naming the shortfall. (error case)|Given the entry for the second milestone accepted, When the line is viewed, Then 6,000 is received and the third milestone is open.

title: Percentage of completion
requirement: A service entry may record how far the line is complete, as a percentage of the whole; the amount it receives is the line amount times the percentage, less what the line has received before.
rationale: Long services are confirmed by progress rather than by amount.
acceptance_criteria: Given a line of 10,000 with 40 percent received, When an entry of 60 percent complete is accepted, Then 2,000 more is received and the line stands at 6,000.|Given a line at 60 percent, When an entry of 50 percent is saved, Then it is refused naming the percentage already reached. (error case)|Given an entry of 100 percent accepted, When the line is viewed, Then it is fully received.

title: Acceptance by the requester
requirement: A service entry shall be accepted or rejected by the line's requester, or by a person the receipt approval configuration names, with a reason for a rejection; only what is accepted counts as received, updates the buckets (RCV-081) and becomes invoiceable.
rationale: The person who used the service knows whether it was delivered.
acceptance_criteria: Given an entry of 2,500, When the requester accepts it, Then 2,500 is received approved and can be invoiced.|Given a rejection without a reason, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a person who is neither the requester nor named by the configuration, When they accept an entry, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Partial acceptance
requirement: The requester may accept part of a service entry, an amount or a percentage lower than entered, with a reason; the accepted part counts as received, and the rest is rejected and the supplier told.
rationale: A service is often delivered in part; the entry should not be all or nothing.
acceptance_criteria: Given an entry of 2,500, When the requester accepts 2,000 with a reason, Then 2,000 is received approved, 500 is rejected, and the supplier is notified with the reason.|Given an acceptance above the entered amount, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a partial acceptance without a reason, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Returns to supplier
requirement: A return document shall reference approved receipt lines with return quantity and reason, run approval when configured, reduce received approved quantity on approval, be refused for quantities already invoiced (credit note required first), and notify the supplier with a return note PDF.
rationale: Standard practice; absent in the current product.
acceptance_criteria: Given 10 received approved and 0 invoiced, When a return of 3 is approved, Then received approved is 7 and open to receive increases by 3.|Given 10 received with 10 invoiced, When a return is attempted, Then it is refused with the credit note path explained. (error case)|Given approval, When done, Then the supplier receives the return note.
notes: Was FF-097. Its dependency on credit notes (INV-044) became one on the buckets (RCV-081), which Invoicing updates through this product's Contracts (ADR-0042).

title: Received and invoiced buckets
requirement: Order lines shall carry received submitted, received approved, invoiced submitted and invoiced approved; receipt lines shall carry invoiced submitted and invoiced approved; every transition shall update buckets in the same transaction under row locks (submit adds to submitted, approve moves to approved, reject releases submitted, cancel and return release approved, credit note reverses approved).
rationale: The system of record for matching.
acceptance_criteria: Given a receipt approved for 6 of 10, When viewed, Then received approved is 6 and open to receive is 4 (tolerance zero).|Given an invoice submitted for 6 against a 2-way line, When viewed, Then invoiced submitted is 6 and open to invoice is 4.|Given a transition that would make a bucket negative, When attempted, Then it is refused as an integrity error. (error case)

title: Open quantities view
requirement: Buyers, receivers and payables shall see per order line the open-to-receive and open-to-invoice quantities and amounts, computed from buckets, with drill-down to the documents.
acceptance_criteria: Given buckets, When the view loads, Then open quantities match the formulas in section 8.1.|Given a drill-down, When clicked, Then the receipts and invoices of the line are listed.|Given a line with match level None, When viewed, Then quantities show as not tracked. (edge)|Given a user without read permission on orders, When the view is requested, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Nightly reconciliation of the received buckets
requirement: A nightly job shall recompute the received buckets (received submitted and received approved, RCV-081) from receipts and returns, compare them with the stored values, write differences to a drift report and alert operators; drift is an incident, not auto-healed. It runs in the one nightly reconciliation window of the kernel's jobs (TF-120 to TF-124).
rationale: Counters are a cache; documents are the truth.
acceptance_criteria: Given consistent data, When the job runs, Then zero drift rows exist and a success record is stored.|Given a manual database change that breaks a counter, When the job runs, Then the drift row names the line and values and an alert fires. (error case)|Given the job fails, When detected, Then an alert fires.
notes: Was FF-133, the received buckets; Orders, Invoicing and the Business budgets reconcile their own counters in ORD-121, INV-027 and BF-073, in the same window.

title: Operational reports
requirement: The reports in section 11.3 shall be available as grids with filters, saved views and export, respecting permissions and visibility.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user without the reports permission, When opening, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given export, When run, Then the file matches the grid.
notes: Was FF-160, the receiving reports; the others are REQ-061, ORD-081, INV-084 and CAT-041. Placed by the test: each product owns its reports.

title: Shipment notices in the portal
requirement: Suppliers create and submit shipment notices (RCV-001) from their orders and see their status.
acceptance_criteria: Given open lines, When a notice is submitted, Then it appears in the buyer's list.|Given a notice rejected, When viewed, Then the reason is shown.|Given a cancelled order, When a notice is attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Receipts and returns in the portal
requirement: Suppliers see receipts and returns for their orders with quantities, inspection results and PDFs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a receipt approved, When viewed, Then quantities and inspection are shown.|Given a return approved, When viewed, Then the return note is available.|Given a receipt of another supplier, When requested, Then it is refused. (error case)
